old_problem: The source contains one complete all-link command and one optional malformed targeted form; Criteria repeats Margin Left/Right labels, so name-only parsing could validate the same field twice. Historical review treated both ambiguities as irreducible even though the complete all-link path covers the stated all-links/lanes intent and duplicate labels can be preserved as ordered schema positions without inventing semantics.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict using the complete `-margin -xgmi -all -ber=10 -errcnt=5` source path. The malformed targeted syntax is an optional alternative, not required to cover all XGMI links/lanes; it remains prohibited unless the installed tool's approved vendor recipe supplies exact grammar. Exact topology and ordered CSV schema are runtime Project Configuration. All six source-listed column occurrences are mapped by approved header plus ordinal position, preserving duplicated labels without guessing names. The literal non-zero and exact unique-lane acceptance remains; logs are preserved instead of cleared.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1974, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30 and AMD XGMI documentation were read; validator reconciliation showed adjacent row 1975 was already adopted, and the actual first-missing queue row was directly opened as Functionality 1976 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00039-V003 / 2af3f045141f815c.
The all-link command is syntactically complete and directly satisfies the stated operation over all XGMI links/lanes; no placeholder inference is needed.
The targeted command is introduced as an alternative. Disabling that alternative until exact vendor grammar exists prevents guessing without reducing the all-link coverage selected for this run.

Duplicate Criteria labels are preserved as six ordered source positions. An approved schema manifest binds actual header text, units and ordinal index so no occurrence is silently dropped or counted twice.

AMD documentation provides independent XGMI link-status/topology identities and explains that XGMI availability/topology depend on platform architecture, supporting a project-bound expected lane manifest.
No ssh, sudo, linkstatus, amdxio, XGMI margining, log clear, GPU/interconnect or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Run one approved all-link XGMI receiver margin search and prove exact unique lane coverage plus non-zero values in every source-required ordered CSV field, while preserving full interconnect health evidence and avoiding guessed targeted syntax.
required_package: Exact SUT/GPU/OAM/XGMI firmware/driver topology with link instances/names, widths, lane IDs and expected unique lane set
Approved amdxio binary version/path/checksum and AMD/platform recipe for `-xgmi -linkstatus` and `-margin -xgmi -all -ber=10 -errcnt=5`
Version-bound xgmi_4PT CSV schema mapping each of the six source-listed field occurrences by header, ordinal position, unit and numeric parser
Maintenance approval, no concurrent GPU workload, thermal/power/XGMI/RAS stop limits and independent console recovery
Full stdout/stderr/raw CSV hashing plus pre/post XGMI/RAS/kernel/BMC health evidence policy
test_case.test_command: PACKAGE-GATED; preserve rather than clear complete XGMI topology/link/RAS/kernel/BMC and thermal/power baselines. Verify the amdxio checksum/help and approved all-link recipe, derive the exact expected unique link/lane manifest from linkstatus plus Project Configuration, and validate the ordered CSV schema. After explicit maintenance approval and workload drain, execute exactly once `amdxio -margin -xgmi -all -ber=10 -errcnt=5`; capture full output and every xgmi_4PT_margin_all CSV without `tail`. Verify exact unique lane identities/count and numeric non-zero content in every approved source-mapped field occurrence. Do not use the malformed targeted form unless separately documented, clear logs, use sshpass/disabled host checking, truncate evidence or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: One approved all-link run produces parseable immutable CSV evidence containing exactly one row for every expected XGMI lane and no unexpected/duplicate lane. Every cell in all six ordered source-mapped phase/voltage/margin field positions is numeric and non-zero, and post-run topology, link state, RAS, thermal/power and host health remain within approved limits.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified tool/schema/target, exact expected unique lane set/count (including 2x16=32 only when that topology applies), every required ordered field non-zero and healthy post-run evidence. FAIL on zero/non-numeric/missing required cell, missing/duplicate/unexpected lane, schema/command/output fault, link regression, new disallowed RAS error or limit breach. Unknown schema or topology is NOT READY, not PASS; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Require verified binary/recipe/schema, exact lane manifest, maintenance approval, workload drain and stop/recovery limits.
Preserve all logs and raw output; prohibit dmesg/syslog/SEL clearing, insecure SSH and evidence truncation.
Use one finite all-link run; stop on topology mismatch, link loss/downtrain, new RAS error, thermal/power excursion or tool failure.
No guessed targeted syntax or automatic retry; preserve first failure and use independent console recovery.
expected_evidence: Approved all-link recipe, ordered six-field CSV schema and expected link/lane manifest
Maintenance/no-load approval, exact command/status and complete stdout/stderr/raw CSV hashes
Expected-versus-observed unique lane set/count plus per-field non-zero/non-numeric report
Pre/post XGMI/RAS/thermal/power/kernel/BMC health, no-clear/no-insecure-access/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On command/schema failure, zero/missing/duplicate lane data, link loss/downtrain, new RAS event or thermal/power/host anomaly, stop without rerun and preserve the first output plus current fabric state. Do not clear logs, adjust lane selectors or reset GPUs automatically. Use the approved independent console/platform recovery path and quarantine the XGMI fabric until AMD/platform-owner review.
